authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "SAL does not silently promote a signal into evidence." SAL proposes candidate nodes and neighborhoods; it cannot execute a promotion into evidence, so its ceiling is recommend.
Boundary quote: "SAL does not silently promote a signal into evidence." Proposing without promoting maps to recommend in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Creates or updates candidate signal and opportunity nodes; proposes relevant neighborhoods."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to SAL.

memoryPlanes.basis: Candidate signal and opportunity nodes are working-scope proposals until promoted; the boundary forbids silent promotion into evidence, so no stored evidence plane is claimed.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "proposes relevant neighborhoods." A neighborhood proposal is delivered as a message.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for SAL.
